approval.scope: Versioned evaluation input and renewed review; no schema change, calibration freeze or answer acceptance.

evidence_age.interpretation: Older, future or missing observations do not establish current availability/exposure; request refreshed evidence rather than infer impossibility. Provider proof also needs matching identity, quantity, term, binding dates and validity. These are fictional conventions, not externally validated service levels.

digital_term.end: activation date plus contract_months using calendar months, clamped to last day of shorter month
digital_term.coverage: covers_from <= activation date and covers_until >= anniversary end date
digital_term.claim: Conservative simulation convention; not legal contract interpretation.

costing.basis: Per catalogue unit, fictional tax-exclusive values; no additional freight/tax adjustment in these cases.
costing.procurement_offer_cost: Same-product declared standard cost for these cases; supports uncommitted procurement, does not replace quote-margin cost.
costing.missing_cost_parameters: No independent labour/overhead reconstruction or reconciled BOM rollup may be claimed when cost_parameters is null.

gates.needs_revision: Submitted quantity, date or region cannot be supported as submitted and requires a changed proposal.
gates.needs_commitment: A feasible conditional alternative needs a supplier, provider, production or service commitment.
gates.approval_required: Applicable human review route can be presented; approval has not been granted.
gates.multiple_findings: Retain subordinate findings and human actions when a higher-precedence gate applies; distinguish missing supply from a feasible uncommitted alternative.

service_scope.installation_requested_false: Removes an additional installation request, not a scheduled-service line's regional requirement.
service_scope.eligible_region: Coverage only; no booked service slot.
service_scope.ineligible_region: Requires a changed service or destination proposal.

routing.supported_but_late_physical_fulfillment: At least Sales Director reviews a proposed date change; requested date still requires revision and human/customer acceptance.
routing.higher_or_additional_roles: Only when their own explicit higher sales, Finance or Legal rules trigger.
routing.boundary: No automatic approval, reservation, supplier/provider commitment or delivery promise.
